A side-by-side description of the two cohorts as analysed (Table S10),
and the mixed model of log10 VAF on age and cohort with sex and smoking as
covariates and within strata of sex.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
source("R/Set_colors.R")
out_res <- "results/paper/"
out_fig <- "figures/paper/additional/"
for (d in c(out_res, out_fig)) dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
main_genes <- c("DNMT3A", "TET2", "ASXL1", "PPM1D", "TP53")
```

# Data

```{r data}
shcs <- read.table("resources/chip_calls_long_filtered.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(Cohort = "SHCS", ID = as.character(ID), traj_id, Gene = Gene.refGene, Type = ExonicFunc.refGene, Age, AF,
            source, lod_depth, lod_vaf, male = SEX == 1, ever_smoked = CV_SMOKED == 1)
sard <- read.table("resources/LoD/sardinia_chip_calls_long_filtered.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble()
smoke <- read.table("resources/SardiNIA/smoke.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(SardID) %>%
  summarise(ever_smoked = any(CurrentSmoker == "Y" | QuitSmoking == "Y" | (!is.na(PackYears) & PackYears > 0), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
sard <- sard %>%
  left_join(smoke, by = "SardID") %>%
  transmute(Cohort = "SardiNIA", ID = as.character(ID), traj_id, Gene = Gene.refGene, Type, Age = Age_exact,
            AF, source, lod_depth, lod_vaf, male = Gender == "M", ever_smoked)
both <- bind_rows(shcs, sard) %>% mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("SardiNIA", "SHCS")))
cat("Smoking known in SardiNIA for", n_distinct(sard$ID[!is.na(sard$ever_smoked)]), "of", n_distinct(sard$ID), "individuals\n")
```

# Table: the two cohorts as analysed

```{r table}
fmt_iqr <- function(x, d = 1) sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f (%.", d, "f-%.", d, "f)"), median(x, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
fmt_pct <- function(x) sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))

per_ind <- both %>% group_by(Cohort, ID) %>%
  summarise(male = first(male), ever_smoked = first(ever_smoked), n_traj = n_distinct(traj_id), n_samples = n_distinct(Age),
            first_age = min(Age), last_age = max(Age), fup = max(Age) - min(Age), .groups = "drop")
per_traj <- both %>% group_by(Cohort, traj_id, Gene) %>%
  summarise(n_tp = n(), n_imputed = sum(source == "imputed"), max_af = max(AF), gap = median(diff(sort(unique(Age)))),
            Type = first(Type), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(gene5 = ifelse(Gene %in% main_genes, Gene, "Other"),
         missense = Type %in% c("nonsynonymous SNV", "nonsynonymous_SNV"))

row <- function(name, f) tibble(Characteristic = name, SHCS = f("SHCS"), SardiNIA = f("SardiNIA"))
tab <- bind_rows(
  row("Individuals", function(c) as.character(n_distinct(per_ind$ID[per_ind$Cohort == c]))),
  row("Trajectories", function(c) as.character(sum(per_traj$Cohort == c))),
  row("Trajectories in the 5 main genes", function(c) as.character(sum(per_traj$Cohort == c & per_traj$Gene %in% main_genes))),
  row("Male sex, n (%)", function(c) fmt_pct(per_ind$male[per_ind$Cohort == c])),
  row("Ever smoked, n (%) of those with data", function(c) fmt_pct(per_ind$ever_smoked[per_ind$Cohort == c])),
  row("Individuals with smoking data", function(c) as.character(sum(!is.na(per_ind$ever_smoked[per_ind$Cohort == c])))),
  row("Age at first sample, years, median (IQR)", function(c) fmt_iqr(per_ind$first_age[per_ind$Cohort == c])),
  row("Age at last sample, years, median (IQR)", function(c) fmt_iqr(per_ind$last_age[per_ind$Cohort == c])),
  row("Follow-up per individual, years, median (IQR)", function(c) fmt_iqr(per_ind$fup[per_ind$Cohort == c])),
  row("Samples per individual, median (IQR)", function(c) fmt_iqr(per_ind$n_samples[per_ind$Cohort == c], 0)),
  row("Timepoints per trajectory, median (IQR)", function(c) fmt_iqr(per_traj$n_tp[per_traj$Cohort == c], 0)),
  row("Interval between timepoints, years, median (IQR)", function(c) fmt_iqr(per_traj$gap[per_traj$Cohort == c])),
  row("Depth at the variant, median (IQR)", function(c) fmt_iqr(both$lod_depth[both$Cohort == c], 0)),
  row("Limit of detection, % VAF, median (IQR)", function(c) fmt_iqr(100 * both$lod_vaf[both$Cohort == c], 2)),
  row("Timepoints not detected (imputed at LoD/2), n (%)", function(c) fmt_pct(both$source[both$Cohort == c] == "imputed")),
  row("Maximum VAF per trajectory, %, median (IQR)", function(c) fmt_iqr(100 * per_traj$max_af[per_traj$Cohort == c])),
  row("DNMT3A, n (%)", function(c) fmt_pct(per_traj$gene5[per_traj$Cohort == c] == "DNMT3A")),
  row("TET2, n (%)", function(c) fmt_pct(per_traj$gene5[per_traj$Cohort == c] == "TET2")),
  row("ASXL1, n (%)", function(c) fmt_pct(per_traj$gene5[per_traj$Cohort == c] == "ASXL1")),
  row("PPM1D, n (%)", function(c) fmt_pct(per_traj$gene5[per_traj$Cohort == c] == "PPM1D")),
  row("TP53, n (%)", function(c) fmt_pct(per_traj$gene5[per_traj$Cohort == c] == "TP53")),
  row("Other genes, n (%)", function(c) fmt_pct(per_traj$gene5[per_traj$Cohort == c] == "Other")),
  row("Missense variants, n (%)", function(c) fmt_pct(per_traj$missense[per_traj$Cohort == c])))
knitr::kable(tab)
write.table(tab, paste0(out_res, "cohort_characteristics_SHCS_SardiNIA.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

tests <- tibble(
  Characteristic = c("Male sex", "Ever smoked", "Age at first sample", "Follow-up", "Interval between timepoints", "Depth", "LoD", "Maximum VAF"),
  p = c(fisher.test(table(per_ind$Cohort, per_ind$male))$p.value,
        fisher.test(table(per_ind$Cohort, per_ind$ever_smoked))$p.value,
        wilcox.test(first_age ~ Cohort, per_ind)$p.value, wilcox.test(fup ~ Cohort, per_ind)$p.value,
        wilcox.test(gap ~ Cohort, per_traj)$p.value, wilcox.test(lod_depth ~ Cohort, both)$p.value,
        wilcox.test(lod_vaf ~ Cohort, both)$p.value, wilcox.test(max_af ~ Cohort, per_traj)$p.value))
knitr::kable(tests %>% mutate(p = signif(p, 2)))
```

# Mixed models with sex and smoking

Model of the cohort comparison (Figure 4): log10(VAF) ~ age (centred at 65) + cohort, random intercept and slope per
trajectory, on the measured timepoints of the unmatched and the matched age-filtered sets of the 5 main genes.
Here the same model is fitted with sex, with sex and smoking (complete cases), and within each sex.

```{r models}
read_set <- function(name) read.table(sprintf("resources/LoD/SHCS_Sardinia_%s_trajectories.txt", name), sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(data_point == 1) %>%
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID), Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Sardinia", "SHCS")), Age_c = Age - 65) %>%
  left_join(per_ind %>% select(ID, male, ever_smoked), by = "ID")
sets <- list(unmatched = read_set("unmatched"), matched_age_filtered = read_set("matched_age_filtered"))

fit_one <- function(d, formula, label, set) {
  m <- lmer(formula, data = d, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
  tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    transmute(set, model = label, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, n_traj = n_distinct(d$traj_id), n_meas = nrow(d),
              converged = is.null(m@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages))
}
res <- map_dfr(names(sets), function(s) {
  d <- sets[[s]]
  bind_rows(
    fit_one(d, log10(VAF) ~ Age_c + Cohort + (Age_c | traj_id), "age + cohort", s),
    fit_one(d, log10(VAF) ~ Age_c + Cohort + male + (Age_c | traj_id), "age + cohort + sex", s),
    fit_one(filter(d, !is.na(ever_smoked)), log10(VAF) ~ Age_c + Cohort + male + ever_smoked + (Age_c | traj_id), "age + cohort + sex + smoking (complete cases)", s),
    fit_one(filter(d, male), log10(VAF) ~ Age_c + Cohort + (Age_c | traj_id), "men only", s),
    fit_one(filter(d, !male), log10(VAF) ~ Age_c + Cohort + (Age_c | traj_id), "women only", s),
    fit_one(d, log10(VAF) ~ Age_c * Cohort + male + (Age_c | traj_id), "age x cohort + sex", s))
})
res %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), ~ round(.x, 3)), p.value = signif(p.value, 2)) %>% knitr::kable()
write.table(res, paste0(out_res, "mixed_models_sex_smoking.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r forest, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
fp <- res %>% filter(term == "CohortSHCS") %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = rev(unique(model))), set = factor(set, levels = c("unmatched", "matched_age_filtered"), labels = c("Unmatched", "Matched, age-filtered")))
p <- ggplot(fp, aes(y = model, x = estimate, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(color = "red3") +
  facet_wrap(~set) +
  labs(x = "HIV effect on log10 VAF (95% CI)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(strip.background = element_blank())
p
ggsave(paste0(out_fig, "HIV_effect_sex_smoking_forest.png"), p, width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)
```

# Age at 2% VAF by sex

```{r age2}
ages <- bind_rows(read.table("resources/LoD/SHCS_trajectories_threshold_ages.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>% mutate(Cohort = "SHCS"),
                  read.table("resources/LoD/Sardinia_trajectories_threshold_ages.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>% mutate(Cohort = "SardiNIA")) %>%
  left_join(per_traj %>% select(traj_id, Gene), by = "traj_id") %>%
  mutate(ID = sub(":.*", "", traj_id)) %>%
  left_join(per_ind %>% select(ID, male), by = "ID") %>%
  filter(Gene %in% main_genes, !is.na(Age_0.02))
age_tab <- ages %>% group_by(sex = ifelse(male, "men", "women"), Cohort) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_Age_0.02 = median(Age_0.02), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Cohort, values_from = c(n, median_Age_0.02))
age_p <- ages %>% group_by(sex = ifelse(male, "men", "women")) %>% summarise(p = wilcox.test(Age_0.02 ~ Cohort)$p.value)
age_tab <- left_join(age_tab, age_p, by = "sex")
knitr::kable(age_tab)
write.table(age_tab, paste0(out_res, "age_at_2pct_by_sex.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
summary(lm(Age_0.02 ~ Cohort + male, data = ages))$coefficients
```
